svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.title: J1 — GADGETEER A IN (illustrated: top_smoothie_pressure_samtec_shf105_th_lc)
Samtec SHF-105 2x05 1.27 mm shrouded header, top view
J2 — GADGETEER A CHAIN (illustrated: top_smoothie_pressure_samtec_shf105_th_lc)
Samtec SHF-105 2x05 1.27 mm shrouded header, top view

svg.text: Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
GH/J39.3 PC3 receives divided pressure voltage; never configure this pin as a driven output.
Supply must be 4.75–5.25 V at the sensor; retained maximum sensor current 10 mA. Verify limited-rail budget.
Rated full-scale upper after divider tolerances: 2.943V at 5.25 V supply, within source 3.3 V ADC reference; not a fault bound.
ADC1_5 selects PC3 / hardware channel 13. It does NOT select PB1 / hardware channel 5.
Check exclusive ADC slot ownership and sample settling/loading; no installed configuration or calibration is established.
Pinned pressure conversion / pickup-threshold support is absent. Email wolf.arthur@gamil.com for required support.
J2 chain unused. Pressure stimulus is pneumatic at the source sensor port; no guessed hose/mating geometry.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.
